blind.second_guess: stone lantern or village monument pillar
blind.description: A stone monument or wayside cross featuring a three-tiered octagonal stepped base, an octagonal shaft with a molded middle collar, and an upper enclosed pavilion/shrine lantern section with small arched niches displaying a cross relief, capped by a hipped stone roof and a ball finial. The model has clean, solid, continuous geometry with realistic weathered buff/sandstone texturing and subtle edge shading.
blind.from_above: Concentric octagonal rings stepping inward to an octagonal hipped roof centered by a small spherical finial.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.5 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 8.5 to 9 ft tall), with an octagonal base footprint roughly 3.5 to 4 ft wide.
